name: Skeleton load
oneLiner: a floating glass page shows only its loading skeleton, grey blocks with a light shimmer sweeping across them, then the page resolves block by block into the brand's real screen, each block lifting out of blur, the headline block landing last with a push-in while the spinner turns into a green check
say: when the speaker says the page or app comes together ('it built the whole site', 'and the page just loads in', 'watch it fill in'): the skeleton holds on the setup, the blocks resolve as they say it built it
